name: Northstar
tagline: Product analytics that a whole team can actually use
positioning: Land bottom-up on DX, expand on governance. The middle Beacon leaves open and Pulsegrid can't reach.

pages.title: Northstar — Pricing
pages.text: Northstar charges per event with unlimited seats on every plan. Free includes 2M events per month and 30-day retention. Team is $199/month for 20M events with 12-month retention, warehouse sync every 15 minutes, and SSO included — not gated behind an enterprise call. Enterprise adds audit logs, SCIM, custom retention and a DPA. No annual commitment is required at any tier and overages bill at the standard per-event rate.

pages.title: Northstar Docs — Quickstart
pages.text: One snippet, events flow immediately, identify() optional with retroactive stitching. Web SDK is 11kb gzipped. Server-side ingestion on every plan including Free.

pricing.notes: Audit logs, SCIM, custom retention, DPA

reviews.quote: SSO at $199 is the whole reason we chose it. Every competitor wanted an annual contract to get past the security review.

changelog.entry: SSO moved down to Team tier
